sources.title: PBOC Shanghai same-city data centre: design-services tender at 1581 Zhenguang Road
sources.publisher: 中国人民银行集中采购中心 (People’s Bank of China Centralized Procurement Center)
sources.source_family: 中国人民银行集中采购中心 (People’s Bank of China Centralized Procurement Center)
sources.attribution: 中国人民银行集中采购中心 (People’s Bank of China Centralized Procurement Center)
sources.summary: The design tender identifies the Jindianyun Shanghai campus at 1581 Zhenguang Road. The planned retrofit uses the main building’s sixth floor and below, with associated support areas, with approximately 650 general-compute and AI cabinets. Its 13,240-square-metre figure describes the existing main building; it is not a data-hall area. The main building has nine aboveground floors and one basement. The 420-day construction period is a tender planning duration, not an achieved work interval.
sources.original_title: 人民银行上海同城数据中心建设项目-设计服务项目招标公告
sources.institutional_author: 中国金融电子化集团有限公司 (China Financial Electronic Corporation)
sources.date_semantics: Visible PBOC publication 2026-10-10 17:36:21; a new design tender confirms an announced proposal, not the first-ever announcement, permit, start or opening. Original page invitation now runs October11–16 and submission November2, distinct from earlier September syndicated notices.

sources.summary: The September 22 notice names China Electronics Engineering Design Institute as the successful technical-consultancy supplier and Jindianyun (Shanghai) Digital Technology as purchaser. The contract award is for consulting services; it does not establish construction, consent or operation.

sources.attribution: 上海市普陀区档案馆 (Shanghai Putuo District Archives)
sources.summary: The district archive’s account of 2013 identifies Shanghai Bill Clearing Centre at 1581 Zhenguang Road. This historical name links the community-mapped host building to the address specified by the current design tender. The archive does not establish the 2026 data-centre project’s status or a current corporate ownership relationship.
sources.date_semantics: Page publication July3,2015; the relocation appears in the September2013 section without a day. Historical property identity only.

sources.title: Shanghai Bill Clearing Centre host building, OpenStreetMap way 957024148
sources.summary: Community-mapped building named Shanghai Bill Clearing Centre. The marker locates this host property for the planned data-centre retrofit, without asserting a surveyed boundary or the location of particular future machine rooms.
sources.date_semantics: Map edit timestamps are not physical-status observations. Current location identity comes from the October10 official tender and historical property-name bridge.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap road and building context around 1581 Zhenguang Road
sources.summary: The named host feature lies west of Zhenguang Road, north of Caoan Road, east of Wanzhen Road and south of Jintang Road. This corroborates broad road context; it does not validate the tender’s boundary offsets or an official parcel.
sources.date_semantics: Retrieved map context, not a current physical-status observation.
